scripts.build: for t in linux-x64 linux-arm64 darwin-arm64 darwin-x64; do bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-$t src/main.tsx --define "process.env.OPENWALLET_DEFAULT_SERVER=\"${OPENWALLET_PUBLIC_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8470}\"" --outfile ../../dist/cli/openwallet-$t || exit 1; done && grep -oP 'const VERSION = "\K[^"]+' src/main.tsx > ../../dist/cli/VERSION
